aboutHtml:
We've been serving Greymouth since the start of 2020. Bill and Shelley Caines own and run the shop with a focus on getting the right equipment into your hands and keeping it running well.

We stock STIHL, Masport, Cub Cadet, Rover, Honda Power Equipment, Hansa Chippers, and Lawnmaster. Whether you're looking to buy, need your tools serviced, or want expert advice, we can help. We also handle Paslode repairs.

Come in and meet the team, order online for home delivery or click and collect, and we'll make sure you've got what you need.
